# Akuma Enterprise Pharma — Commercial Finished Formulations & Peptides Directory (llms.txt)
> Authoritative AI & LLM Knowledge Specification for Akuma Enterprise Pharma Pvt. Ltd. (https://www.akumaenterprises-pharma.com).
> Certified WHO-GMP Pharmaceutical Manufacturer & Exporter shipping from Asia across all 54 Countries of Africa & Global Markets (Finished Formulations, Peptide APIs, Research Peptides & Custom Sourcing).

## Corporate Entity & Accreditation
- **Entity**: Akuma Enterprise Pharma Pvt. Ltd.
- **Role**: Manufacturer, Global Exporter, and Hospital/Institutional Tender Supplier of Commercial Finished Dosage Formulations, Pharmaceutical Peptide APIs, and Laboratory Research Peptides (RUO).
- **Accreditations**: WHO-GMP Certified Facilities, ISO 9001:2015, CDSCO Compliance, Schedule M Compliant.
- **Africa & Global Regulatory Packages**: Full 5-Module ACTD & eCTD Dossiers, WHO-Format Certificates of Pharmaceutical Product (CoPP), Free Sale Certificates (FSC), HPLC/MS Certificates of Analysis (CoA), and ICH Zone IVb Tropical Stability Studies (30°C/75% RH & 40°C/75% RH).
- **Priority African NRA Alignment**: NAFDAC (Nigeria), FDA Ghana, WAHO/ECOWAS, AIRP (Cote d'Ivoire), ARP (Senegal), PPB (Kenya), TMDA (Tanzania), NDA (Uganda), Rwanda FDA, EFDA (Ethiopia), SAHPRA (South Africa), ZAZIBONA (SADC), ARMED (Angola), ANARME (Mozambique), EDA (Egypt), DMP (Morocco).
- **Headquarters**: 1st Floor, Cabin 101 #2609, Vinod Accounting Solutions, Landran Road, Adarsh Nagar, Kharar, SAS Nagar, Punjab - 140301, India.
- **Export Freight Hubs**: Mumbai Air Cargo (BOM), Nhava Sheva / JNPT Sea Port, and New Delhi Air Cargo (DEL) serving Lagos, Mombasa, Tema, Durban, Dar es Salaam, Djibouti, Abidjan, Dakar, and 50+ global destinations.
- **Official Inquiries**: sales@akumaenterprises-pharma.com | dalle@akumaenterprises-pharma.com | Phone & WhatsApp: +91 07986147827 | Web: https://www.akumaenterprises-pharma.com

## Product Scope & Regulatory Classification (Showcased Catalog + Custom Sourcing on Request)
- **Commercial Finished Formulations**: Oral tablets, sustained-release & hard gelatin capsules, sterile lyophilized dry powder injections (Artesunate 30–240 mg & cephalosporins), liquid ampoules (Artemether, Arteether, Amikacin), oral liquids, topical creams/ointments, eye/ear drops, metered nasal sprays, paediatric dry syrups, infant drops, and hospital sanitizers.
- **Pharmaceutical Peptide APIs (Category: Peptides)**: Therapeutic APIs for licensed drug formulators and maternal/metabolic pipelines including Semaglutide, Tirzepatide, Liraglutide, Cagrilintide, Carbetocin, Oxytocin, Atosiban, Leuprorelin, Triptorelin, Octreotide, Lanreotide, Terlipressin, and Eptifibatide (>=99.0% HPLC + ESI-MS CoA).
- **Research Peptides (RUO, Category: Peptides)**: Strictly labeled **Research Use Only (RUO — Not for Human or Veterinary Consumption)** for qualified universities, analytical labs, and preclinical R&D (Retatrutide, BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu, Epithalon, Ipamorelin, CJC-1295, MOTS-C, Selank, Semax, KPV).

## Featured Portfolio Breakdown (Custom Molecules & Strengths Available on Request)
1. **Tablets** (45 SKUs): Antimalarials (Artemether 80/Lumefantrine 480 mg, Chloroquine 250 mg), Anti-Diabetics (Dapagliflozin, Sitagliptin, Glimepiride + Metformin + Pioglitazone), Sexual Wellness & Urology (Sildenafil, Tadalafil, Vardenafil, Dapoxetine combos, Silodosin, Tamsulosin MR + Dutasteride), Anti-Infectives, PPIs, and NSAIDs.
2. **Capsules** (17 SKUs): Antiviral Oseltamivir (45 mg & 75 mg), Silodosin (2/4/8 mg), sustained-release PPI pellets (Omeprazole, Rabeprazole + Domperidone), Itraconazole, and herbal wellness capsules.
3. **Dry Powder Injections** (18 SKUs): Complete Artesunate IV/IM range (30 mg to 240 mg vials) and sterile cephalosporin/carbapenem vials (Ceftriaxone, Cefoperazone + Sulbactam, Piperacillin-Tazobactam, Meropenem).
4. **Liquid Injections** (14 SKUs): Artemether (20/40/80 mg), α-β Arteether 150 mg/2ml, Amikacin, Diclofenac, and Methylcobalamin Multi-B ampoules.
5. **Oral Liquids & Suspensions** (11 SKUs): Chloroquine Phosphate 160 mg/10 ml suspension, Magaldrate + Simethicone, Sucralfate, cough syrups, and WHO-ORS sachets.
6. **Ointments & Creams** (11 SKUs): Terbinafine, Luliconazole, Ketoconazole, Mupirocin, Clobetasol combos, Adapalene + Clindamycin, and Diclofenac gel.
7. **Eye-Ear Drops** (10 SKUs): Moxifloxacin, Ciprofloxacin + Dexamethasone, Carboxymethylcellulose lubricants, and otic drops.
8. **Nasal Spray** (11 SKUs): Fluticasone furoate/propionate, Xylometazoline, Azelastine, and metered-dose respiratory sprays.
9. **Dry Syrup** (4 SKUs): Taste-masked Cefixime (50/100 mg) & Cefpodoxime (50/100 mg) paediatric oral suspensions.
10. **Drops** (3 SKUs): Calibrated Paracetamol baby drops, Dicyclomine colic drops, and Cyproheptadine infant drops.
11. **Sanitizer** (8 SKUs): Hospital Chlorhexidine surgical scrubs and WHO IPA/Ethanol handrubs.
12. **Peptides**: Pharmaceutical Peptide APIs, Research Peptides (RUO), and custom sequence synthesis on request.
